## Rules

- Reviewer actor/context differs from every implementation/live executor. Before tests, verify P0–P3 closure carriers and P4.1 state are terminal, then hash-bind them and both P4.1 live artifacts in the acceptance JSON. P4.2 performs no network request: live A1/B2 facts come only from P4.1 artifacts/findings/research. Each finding verdict binds old failure signal, new regression/fault command, code anchor, result and evidence IDs. Green full suite without named rollback/negative proof is insufficient. Any in-scope product failure is recorded machine-readably, keeps P4.2 nonterminal and returns an exact remediation scope to the owning item; P4.2 does not edit product files and is rerun by a fresh independent actor after material SHA change. Artifact distinguishes inherited dirty/baseline outcomes from plan delta. Raw command results → `@plan/knowledge/findings-P4-independent-acceptance.json` evidence index → `@plan/knowledge/research-P4-independent-acceptance.json` synthesis → updated acceptance/remediation verdicts, with SHA links at every hop. RAG:— (repo-grounded: plan-protocol evidence-first loop, D11).

## Guidance

Verification/acceptance-carriers/bookkeeping only; app/test/config diff attributable to the independent replay stays empty. The owner may repair a validation carrier before a fresh replay; that repair is hash-bound and reviewed independently. Run P0 migrate/fresh first, then the explicit named matrix recorded in the acceptance JSON (`C05` aggregate backed by `C06` and `C15`–`C21`), then real-worker, targeted broad and full suites. Terminal P0–P3 closures are accepted outcome carriers under Layout v2 and are not treated as repositories of retired command strings. JSON stable keys: `schema_version`, `git_anchor`, `independent_actor`, `source_carriers` (path + SHA-256, including P4.1 state and both live JSONs), `commands`, `findings`, `a1_live_verdict`, `b2_verdict`, `fault_injection`, `test_counts`, `inherited_outcomes`, `task_postflight`. Every finding has `id`, `verdict`, `command_ids`, `evidence_ids`, `source_sha256`; verdict enum is `GREEN`, `RED`, `ATTENTION`. Do not edit an assertion or product source to make acceptance green. A discovered in-scope product defect keeps P4.2 nonterminal until the owning item is repaired and the complete acceptance is replayed fresh.
